product: Payas STEM Dene Yap - Ressam Robot

motor.note: LP without encoder, manufacturer drawing page 4; envelope excludes output shaft. 3AA performance requires load test.

battery_holder.note: Holder face exposed through back window; release two straps and pull complete holder out for battery service. Verify switch not under a strap.

marker.selection_requirement: Straight round barrel 8 to 14 mm diameter, at least 35 mm straight clamping length; height adjustable. This is holder design capacity, not an invented product dimension.

switch.wood_cutout: none; expose holder on service back

fasteners.motor: 2 x M1.6x4 screws (3 mm panel, 1 mm engagement)
fasteners.hub: 4 x M3x5 screws (3 mm crank, 2 mm engagement)
fasteners.moving_joints: 5 mm spacers between crank/rocker and beam; M3x16 moving pins, M3x18 fixed rocker pivot, washers and nyloc nuts. Keep free-running clearance.
fasteners.ties: Releasable 2.5 mm wide ties for pen, battery and service panel; lengths selected at assembly

manufacturing.bridge_status: starting design parameter; verify retained width and holding strength by test cut
manufacturing.bridge_policy: Two registered 1 mm non-cut arclength gaps per outer contour; closed design separately retained in validation report. Snip and sand nibs flush before assembly, especially at mating edges.

export_policy: No fabrication SVG until component interfaces, motion, joints, kerf, intentional bridge gaps and all remaining cut paths validate.
